# Adsbooster.net — Autonomous Multi-Network Advertising & Social Automation Cloud

> Adsbooster.net is an all-in-one advertising automation platform allowing businesses, creators, and agencies to launch multi-network ad campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, Google Ads, Snapchat, and the "All-in-One Combo Pack" simultaneously with AI creative generation, real-time social scheduling, automated split testing, and a built-in credit economy.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Network Ad Engine (`/create-ad.php`)**: Create and launch single or cross-platform combo pack ads across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google Ads, and Snapchat with granular demographic, geo, and interest targeting.
- **AI Campaign Doctor & Copy Studio (`/modules/campaign_doctor.php`, `/post-creator.php`)**: Generate high-converting ad copy, viral hooks, reels scripts, and motivational creatives powered by LLMs.
- **A/B Creative Split Testing (`/ab-test.php`)**: Test up to 4 creative variants with custom traffic splits and automated budget reallocation to statistical winners.
- **Smart Audience Builder (`/audience-builder.php`)**: Demographic cohort builder and heuristic lookalike audience expansion engine.
- **Content Calendar (`/calendar.php`)**: Interactive visual scheduling calendar with drag-to-reschedule and rich text post composition.
- **Real-Time Social Connect (`/social-connect.php`)**: Live OAuth & token integrations with Meta Graph API, TikTok for Business, Google Ads, Snapchat, and Google Calendar.
- **Credit & Subscription Economy (`/billing.php`, `/pricing-plan.php`)**: Transparent subscription tiers (Starter Booster, Growth Pro, Agency Scaling, Enterprise) with bundled Ad Credits and AI Credits, plus separate wallet top-ups via Paystack and Flutterwave.
- **Referral Growth Program (`/referrals.php`)**: Two-way commission and credit rewards on successful referrals and payment activations.
- **Marketplace & Sponsored Ads (`/marketplace.php`)**: Products, services, and company directory featuring dynamic sponsored ad insertions.
- **Peer-to-Peer Chat & Support (`/p2p-chat.php`, `/tickets.php`)**: Real-time customer messaging and rich text ticket management.

## Pricing Plans & Bundled Credits
- **Starter Booster**: $29/mo — Includes $30.00 Ad Credits + 150 AI Credits.
- **Growth Pro (Most Popular)**: $79/mo — Includes $95.00 Ad Credits + 500 AI Credits.
- **Agency Scaling**: $199/mo — Includes $260.00 Ad Credits + 1,500 AI Credits.
- **Enterprise**: $499/mo — Includes $700.00 Ad Credits + 5,000 AI Credits.

## Developer & API Integration
- Base URL: `https://adsbooster.net`
- Developer Console: `/api-settings.php`
- Endpoints:
  - `POST /api/v1/campaigns.php`: Programmatic ad campaign launcher
  - `GET /api/v1/posts.php`: Scheduled post queue and publishing logs
  - `GET /api/v1/credits.php`: Real-time ad credit and AI credit balance inquiry
  - Webhooks: Real-time event notifications (`campaign.status_changed`, `post.published`, `payment.completed`)
